Card Q&A.a: [Security] effects take precedence for activation.  Upon a check, a [Security] effect will immediately activate without pending activation.  For other triggered effects, the turn player activates their effects first.
Card Q&A.q: In what order do a [Security] effect, "when [...] performs a security check" effect, and "when a card is removed from [...] security stack" effect activate when they trigger simultaneously upon a security check?

Card Q&A.a: The card is placed on the bottom of the cards under the Tamer.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [All Turns] effect to place a card under a Tamer with cards under it, in what order do I place the card?
Can I change the stacking order of face-down cards under a Tamer?

Card Q&A.a: Only the player of those cards can search/look at them.  The opponent player can't search/look at them.
Card Q&A.q: Can I search/look at face-down cards under a Tamer?

Card Q&A.a: It's placed face-up in the trash.

Card Q&A.a: You place them 1 at a time under the Tamer starting with the top card of your deck.
Card Q&A.q: When I place multiple cards from the top of my deck face down under a Tamer without looking at them, in what order do I place them?

2 copies of this card are in the battle area.  When my card with the [Glowing Dawn] trait would be played, can I activate the [Your Turn] effects on both copies of this card and reduce the play cost by a total of 2?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[All Turns] When your security stack is removed from, by suspending this Tamer, you may place the top 2 cards of your deck face down under this Tamer.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [Glowing Dawn] trait cards would be played, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, reduce the cost by 1.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
